[[File:Justin Pakes DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Justin Pakes, 2000 Worlds judge. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Justin Pakes''' was a Decipher designer who appeared as a design guest on [[Radio Free Decipher]] episodes about Coruscant, Reflections III and Theed Palace.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014124409/https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Internet Archive]</ref> Early episode indexes bill him as '''Juz Pakes'''.<ref name="rfd" /> He did additional design on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>
